Pain Killer — Cursed Technique Reversal

You have mastered reverse cursed technique and learned the reversal of your technique. You can attempt to touch a creature within 5 feet by succeeding a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check against their AC. On a success, you can spend CE up to your CE modifier to cause them to take 5 additional psychic damage from any source of damage for every 2 CE spent. This lasts for 1 hour and increases with your duration of Pain Killer. At 3rd level, you can use this feature with Practiced Hands.
